Docs.summary: Extracts a shared Documents document from a source stream.
Docs.remarks: Implementations do not own or dispose the source stream. They must snapshot per-call options before asynchronous work, honor cancellation, and release provider resources on failure or cancellation. Cleanup failures must not replace the primary error. The returned document is data and requires no disposal. Providers explicitly populate source frames, including blank frames. Optional native document, payload and source-reference objects remain borrowed; they are not implicitly disposed or deep-cloned. The shared contract does not guarantee original HTTP bytes, response-content retention or durable serialization.
